differential.name: Diabetic kidney disease (diabetic nephropathy)
differential.rationale: Long‑standing T2DM with microalbuminuria, CKD stage 2‑4 and high creatinine fits progressive diabetic nephropathy.

differential.name: Acute pyelonephritis
differential.rationale: Critical‑high leukocytes in urine sediment suggest an active urinary tract infection superimposed on chronic kidney disease.

differential.name: Hypertensive nephrosclerosis
differential.rationale: Metabolic syndrome, likely hypertension, and CKD progression are classic for hypertensive‑related renal injury.

differential.name: Obesity‑related focal segmental glomerulosclerosis (obesity‑FSGS)
differential.rationale: BMI ≈ 27 kg/m², metabolic syndrome and proteinuria raise suspicion for secondary FSGS contributing to CKD.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic kidney disease
differential.rationale: Documented anemia in the setting of CKD and reduced erythropoietin production explains the low RBC indices.
